WITH PlantSpecificAggregates AS
(
    SELECT
        f.[OPERATING_PLNT_KEY],
        f.[PARNT_CUST_KEY],
        SUM(f.[ACTUAL_WRK_IN_HRS]) AS Total_Hours
    FROM [GLOBAL_EDW].[Propelis].[EDW_T_FACT_PRD_TMCONFS_CUR_D] f
    INNER JOIN [GLOBAL_EDW].[Propelis].[POSTING_DATE] d
        ON f.[PSTNG_DATE_KEY] = d.[DATE_KEY]
    WHERE 
        d.[Posting Date] >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1, 1, 1)
        AND d.[Posting Date] <= EOMONTH(GETDATE(), -1)
    GROUP BY
        f.[OPERATING_PLNT_KEY],
        f.[PARNT_CUST_KEY]
),
RankedCustomers AS
(
    SELECT
        [OPERATING_PLNT_KEY],
        [PARNT_CUST_KEY],
        Total_Hours,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY [OPERATING_PLNT_KEY]
            ORDER BY Total_Hours DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM PlantSpecificAggregates
)

UPDATE tgt
SET
    tgt.[Last24M_Total_Hours]   = r.Total_Hours,
    tgt.[Last24M_Customer_Rank] = r.rn
FROM [GLOBAL_EDW].[Propelis].[EDW_T_FACT_PRD_TMCONFS_CUR_D] tgt
INNER JOIN RankedCustomers r
    ON tgt.[OPERATING_PLNT_KEY] = r.[OPERATING_PLNT_KEY]
   AND tgt.[PARNT_CUST_KEY]     = r.[PARNT_CUST_KEY];
